verdict.rationale: Scribe documents several selectable model IDs: zoom-scribe-multilingual and whisper with different language coverage, and zoom-scribe-en-pro described as offering 'higher English accuracy'. That gives developers a real model choice with a qualitative accuracy tradeoff. Fast, live and batch modes address latency, but they are processing modes rather than models, and nothing publishes quantitative accuracy, latency or cost figures per model. Missing for 10: published accuracy benchmarks (e.g. WER) per model, per-model latency figures, per-model pricing/cost tradeoffs, independent corroboration.
